set.body:
Requested by a downstream desktop host (eyes4s Studio), stated generically. Found while building a canvas host on the 56506d2 interaction pieces.

Problem
JavaFxInteractionHost accepts only an InteractionPlan, which only InteractionCompiler builds from a Plot. A host that lowers its own Grob tree and names marks with GraphicsName (NamedPicking) cannot use the host's pointer, keyboard, focus and overlay handling, and has to rebuild that contract itself. NavigationPlan likewise cannot be built for a NamedPickingPlan, so keyboard roving over named marks has to be reimplemented.

Scope
Let the JavaFX host (and NavigationPlan) accept a NamedPickingPlan over a hand-built Scene, with the same pointer, keyboard and overlay behaviour as for compiled plots.

Acceptance criteria
1. A hand-built Scene with named marks can be hosted; pointer hits and keyboard navigation return GraphicsName values identical to NamedPicking.
2. NavigationPlan (next/previous/nearest in direction) is constructible from a NamedPickingPlan, identical on JVM and Scala.js.
3. Additive API; existing compiled-plot hosting unchanged.
set.title: [Intaglio] JavaFX interaction host for hand-built scenes and named picking plans
